text:
anna: Heads-up — seeing a big CPU spike on the telemetry exporter after the routing-policy rollout (07:10 UTC). p99 exporter latency ~2x. Anyone on call?

mike: I'm on. Which exporter / cluster / nodes?

anna: OTLP exporter (telemetry-exporter v2.3.1) on telemetry-prod-2. Correlated with increased span churn after we started attaching per-route attrs. Quick metrics snapshot from node-a: 

```
exporter.cpu: 84%
exporter.p99_latency_ms: 320   # baseline ~170ms
spans/s per node: 12k      # baseline ~4.5k
avg span size: 280 bytes
batch_size_average: 8 spans  # used to be ~64
```

sre-bot: alert: exporter-cpu-high telemetry-prod-2 (2165432123)

jess: batch_size dropping to 8 explains CPU and p99. Likely immediate flushes because batches can't merge (unique attributes). Did the rollout enable per-span immediate flush?

kai: The new routing policy appends route-specific attributes for every request id -> makes almost every span unique. Batching merging goes out the window. Two immediate mitigations: increase batching window / max_batch_size, or add client-side sampling / attribute stabilization.

mike: Config currently: OTLP_EXPORTER_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=20, OTLP_EXPORTER_MAX_BATCH=100. If batch_timeout is tiny and spans are unique, we flush small batches. What if we bump timeout to 100ms and max batch to 128?

anna: That's what I was thinking. Also we could enable a hash-collapsing rule so non-essential route attrs are collapsed to a single stable route_id attr before export.

jess: Quick canary: increase BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS to 100 on one node and enable stable-attr-hash. Also add metrics for batch_fill_ratio and span.merge_rate. If merge_rate improves, that's our cue.

kai: I'll run the canary on telemetry-prod-2/node-a now. ETA ~15m.

mike: Also add short-term 5% head-based sampling for the highest-volume route(s) so we reduce span throughput while we test.

anna: Canary results (after 8m): CPU down -> 58%, p99 -> 210ms, spans/s -> 6.5k, batch_size_avg -> 46. Not fully back to baseline but big improvement.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-034 exporter-batch-thin (linked to alert).

jess: Good. For longer term we need to update routing policy to avoid creating per-request unique tags. Proposal: compute route_hash and attach route_hash + stable metadata, not full attr set. Filing RFC now: https://go/redwood/rfc/route-hash-telemetry (placeholder).

anna: If numbers stay stable for 30m we'll roll the batching change to the rest of the pool and roll back the per-request attr expansion in the routing policy.

mike: I'll coordinate the deploy plan, add rollout steps and rollback script. thanks all. :thumbsup:

anna: Leaving monitoring on. Please DM if you see regressions.
